punisher.name: The Patient Punisher
punisher.description: Maintains wide buffers, waits for attackers to overcommit, and deploys lethal counter-traps

interceptor.name: The Apex Interceptor
interceptor.description: Calculates dynamic intercept triangles and aggressively cuts off vulnerable targets

vacuum.name: The Death-Drop Vacuum
vacuum.description: Prioritizes high-mass food clusters and death drops to maximize rapid body growth

wall_hugger.name: The Perimeter Wall-Hugger
wall_hugger.description: Patrols the outer boundary safe zone away from chaotic center brawls

baiter.name: The Baiter
baiter.description: Feigns cruising speed to lure enemies, then boosts and swings body segments across their path

coiler.name: The Tight Coiler
coiler.description: Excels at encircling smaller opponents to entrap them inside its body circumference

conservative_giant.name: The Conservative Giant
conservative_giant.description: Prioritizes extreme longevity, mass retention, and low-risk defensive steering

flanker.name: The Flanker
flanker.description: Approaches targets from perpendicular blind angles for surprise cut-offs

prey_stalker.name: The Prey Stalker
prey_stalker.description: Relentlessly tracks and consumes erratic wandering fireflies for instant mass boosts

opportunist.name: The Opportunist
opportunist.description: Follows in the wake of larger snakes, harvesting their left-over boost food and dropped mass
